entries.caa57c371770feb1: The company sets out its medium-term management plan "MAP24-26" (from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026) and sets its desired form in 10 years as "Establishment of the global brand O-Well." Under its medium-term management policy, "Innovate and create the value we provide," it states that it will strengthen the value it provides from a "product provision" type to a "one-stop solution provision" type. In the coating-related business, under the priority policy "Create the future of coating," it will pursue functional expansion with coating film formation capabilities at its core, and in the electronics-related business, under the priority policy "Expand the value we provide," it states that it will work on imparting and expanding the functions it delivers.
